 Print The latest episode of Rise and Fall 2 witnessed a major shake-up in the Tower as the Workers successfully overthrew the Rulers in the season’s first Takhta Palat. The dramatic change in power forced the former Rulers to leave the luxurious Penthouse and move to the Basement, turning the tables on contestants who had previously enjoyed authority in the game. The power shift took place after the Printing Press Challenge, in which the Workers secured 66 approved pamphlets and ended the Rulers’ control of the Penthouse, introducing a new set of contestants to the penthouse – although Niharika Tiwari retained her Ultimate Ruler status during the transition. The first Takhta Palat was one of the most dramatic twists of the season till date, as the contestants who had been staying in the Penthouse were sent downstairs and the Workers who had won the latest challenge took their place in the more privileged living quarters. The sudden change meant that the dynamics between the housemates also shifted, the former Rulers were forced to adapt to their new status and the new arrivals in the Penthouse took over. Irina Rudakova also found herself in the midst of a confrontation after Shehzad Poonawalla and Swara Bhaskar spoke about her temperament. The conversation quickly escalated into another confrontation, with Karan Patel and Swara reminding Irina that everyone had the right to express their opinions. The disagreement also added to the tensions which existed between housemates, even after the major change in the competition structure. The situation in which the Workers have taken over the Penthouse will test the housemates’ ability to secure their positions. The former Rulers will have to adapt to their new circumstances and the new arrivals have an opportunity to consolidate their power and make difficult choices in order to ensure they continue to thrive in the Tower. The latest developments in the competition have increased the stakes of the game as new alliances have been formed and rivalries which continue to affect the relationships between housemates have developed. Presented by Virender Sehwag, the show Rise and Fall 2 sees the contestants split into two groups, Rulers and Workers and their status altered as the game progresses. The Takhta Palat has resulted in considerable change within the Tower, setting up further drama for the episodes ahead. Fact-checker’s note: this article has been written with information about the episode which aired on October 23. Before publishing this piece, double-check that each of the four named contestants had been considered a former Ruler in this episode. The report covers the collective shift in power and the Swara–Shehzad–Irina altercation, but does not confirm each one’s individual status.
